claim_scores.rationale: Uses `compiled = optimizer.compile(Student(), ...)` and performs all inspection on `compiled.predictor...`, not on the original student instance.

The deterministic `DummyLM` proposes a new instruction, and the answer proves that proposal appears on the compiled predictor’s signature/prompt text, showing COPRO applied it to the predictor rather than only storing scores elsewhere.
Takes `compiled.predictor.predict.signature` as the proof target and reads the final `instructions` from that compiled predictor.
Prints the optimized instruction and rendered system message from the compiled signature, then asserts the proposed instruction exactly matches and is present in the rendered prompt.

The check is framed around the compiled predictor’s final signature object, consistent with `with_instructions` producing a new signature carrying the updated instructions rather than mutating the original in place.
